name: Teenagers
overview: Scripture recognizes the unique challenges and opportunities in the lives of teenagers, urging both young people and their parents to approach this season with wisdom and discipline. Parents are instructed to train their children in the right way so that they will remain faithful as they grow (Proverbs 22:6), while young people are encouraged to enjoy their youth responsibly, mindful that God will bring them into judgment for their choices (Ecclesiastes 11:9). The spiritual battles faced by youth are real, as even the strong may grow weary or fall (Isaiah 40:30), but through sober-mindedness and reliance on the Spirit, as exemplified by Jesus in His temptation (Matthew 4:1; Titus 2:6), teenagers can overcome sin and rule over it (Genesis 4:7).
